messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: High error rate detected for /v1/generate in hosted-us-west (5xx spike). Thresholds exceeded (30m)
anya (oncall): seeing it, starting investigation. toggling to high-priority. assigning to @sam for runtime traces.
sam: grabbing logs and tailing proxy. 502s appear from grpc gateway -> runtime-1 pool. Repro locally? no. Happening across multiple instances.
mike: adding context — we just rolled runtime 1.14 -> 1.15 at 09:12 UTC earlier today. rolling back? not yet, need root cause.
anya (oncall): can we confirm if this correlates with model-serving stretchers? sampling request ids pls.
sam: pasted qids: `req=7f3a2c.., req=7f3a2d.., req=7f3a2e..` — stack traces show `kv-cache null pointer` in runtime-1 binary at `kv_cache.cpp:142`
jessica (prodops): tagging as P1. Paging SRE for mitigation playbook. Also notifying CS for customer impact assessment.
carlos (support): seeing customer tickets for increased latencies and a handful of timeouts. Escalating to enterprise customers impacted by hosted-us-west.
anya (oncall): mitigation — enabling fallback route to model-variant `gpt-lite-2` via routing policy `route-fallback-2026-03` to reduce error surface. Running now.
sam: rollback patch queued: `deploy rollback runtime-1 1.14` — will wait for canary metrics after routing change.
statuspage-bot: Posted incident on status.redwood.ai with initial message: "Degraded performance for text generation in US-West. Mitigation in progress."
carlos (support): chest-notes — customers A, C, and D affected, A has active production queries; flagged for phone outreach.
mike: found repro sequence in logs: concurrent KV invalidation + aggressive prefetch leads to use-after-free. I can push a hotfix build with bounds check.
anya (oncall): short-term: keep fallback route enabled and scale up `gpt-lite-2` pool by +3 nodes. Long-term: hotfix + deeper test harness.
sam: metrics improving after fallback enabled — 502s down from 7% -> 0.8% in last 6m. continuing to monitor.
pagerbot: INCIDENT: high-errors -> mitigated via routing fallback. Incident state: mitigation in place, oncall monitoring.
anya (oncall): scheduling postmortem. Propose 1hr post-incident review at 1712349200 (UTC) — in #incidents. @jessica can you host doc?
jessica (prodops): yes, creating postmortem doc and template. I'll include timeline, mitigation, RCA, customer comms, and action items.
carlos (support): will draft customer-facing summary for enterprise contacts: short recap + ETA for RCA. want to share within 24h.
anya (oncall): action items (assigning): 1) mike -> hotfix PR with bounds check and unit tests (due EOD). 2) sam -> add canary checks for kv-cache NPEs (due 48h). 3) jessica -> postmortem doc + send initial customer email (due 24h). 4) carlos -> call impacted customers and log outreach (ongoing). 5) anya -> follow up on rollout policy to avoid single-variant blasts (due 72h).
mike: starting hotfix branch `hotfix/kv-npe-171234` now. I’ll run stress harness replicating concurrent invalidation.
jessica (prodops): postmortem doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/1712345678. I’ll add a statuspage update draft for legal review.
carlos (support): customer draft: "We experienced degraded service—mitigation applied (fallback route). We're investigating root cause and will share RCA soon. Contact support@redwood.ai for immediate concerns." Lmk if ok.
anya (oncall): good first draft. Add expected timeline for hotfix and a link to scheduled postmortem.
sam: adding logs/trace snapshots to postmortem doc. Also adding a guard in the proxy so a 502 spike triggers auto-fallback earlier.
pagerbot: REMINDER: Handoff to next oncall in 30m. Current oncall: @anya, Next: @sam.
anya (oncall): handoff notes: current status — mitigation active (fallback), error rate trending down, hotfix in progress, customers notified. watch for rollback necessity.
statuspage-bot: Updated status: "Mitigation applied; partial restoration. Root cause under investigation. Next update in 2 hours."
jessica (prodops): after RCA validated we should push a formal customer RCA to status page and email enterprise customers. Will coordinate with legal for phrasing and charts.
mike: hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/merge_requests/2234 — includes bounds check + added unit test. Running CI now.
sam: monitoring live after hotfix merge; will coordinate canary push once CI green. If stable, we'll schedule a stable rollout with canary gating.
anya (oncall): closing loop: please file action items in the incidents board and mark owners. I'll lead retrospective and ensure follow-ups tracked.
jessica (prodops): posting a short customer-facing RCA draft in the doc and tagging for review: @carlos @anya @legal
carlos (support): logged outreach steps in support tracker. I'll update customers once we confirm hotfix rollout schedule.
anya (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll post final incident summary after the postmortem. Remember to update the incident ticket with links to PR, postmortem, and status page entries. :thumbsup:"
